title: [Task Sprint] QA Testing Report — Villume Admin

issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Redesign the /delete-account page so it matches the new Villume design system.

Background

The current delete account page still needs to be updated visually and structurally. It should feel consistent with the new app experience, especially the updated header, spacing, typography, colors, and button styles.

Expected behavior

  • Update /delete-account to use the new design direction.
  • Keep the delete account flow clear and easy to understand.
  • Make the page responsive on desktop and mobile.
  • Use clear warning and confirmation states so users understand the action.
  • Preserve the existing account deletion behavior unless a separate product decision changes it.

Notes

This is primarily a design refresh. The page should look current without changing the underlying delete-account intent.

Demo by Developer

QA Review - 2026-08-07

Result: Passed

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/profile/issue_1714_delete_account_redesign.spec.ts

Test Summary

# Method Scenario Expected result Observed result Matrix Result
1 White box Design-system implementation review Route has the refreshed, scoped structure, typography, colors, spacing, and recovery copy Scoped villume-delete-account layout uses design tokens, responsive spacing, warning/recovery content, and a dedicated recovery action TP Pass
2 Gray box Recovery flow on real Dev site Selecting Restore Your Profile opens account recovery sign-in without invoking deletion Real Dev page opened the Welcome back sign-in dialog; no request to /v1/users/deactivate was observed TP Pass
3 Black box Tablet and mobile usability Core copy and action remain visible without horizontal overflow Verified at tablet 768x1024 and mobile 390x844; mobile horizontal overflow was 0 px TP Pass
4 Safety boundary Irreversible account deletion No deletion should be executed during visual-refresh QA No delete endpoint request or destructive action was sent TN Pass

Code Review

Area Result
Route /delete-account resolves to the dedicated standalone DeleteAccountComponent.
Design system The page is scoped under .villume-delete-account and uses shared CSS variables for foreground, background, accent, primary color, typography, spacing, and responsive sizing.
Responsive behavior clamp() typography and padding plus flexible action layout preserve a readable desktop, tablet, and mobile layout.
Recovery behavior The recovery action sets the existing login-dialog state; it does not call account deactivation.

Test Methods and Confusion Matrix

Classification Definition in this QA Count
True positive Intended redesign/recovery behavior shown correctly 3
True negative Destructive deletion was not triggered by the recovery-page action 1
False positive UI appears successful while triggering deletion 0 observed
False negative Intended recovery action fails to open login 0 observed

Evidence

All evidence was captured on screen 1 (left / DISPLAY1); screen 2 was not used or recorded. The video includes the browser address bar, shows the complete /delete-account page first, then the safe recovery-login dialog.

Developer Bug Notes

No coding bug was found.
